leadText: Karen Fukuhara (born February 10, 1992) is an American actress. She is known for her roles as /Katana in the 2016 superhero film and as Kimiko Miyashiro in the Prime Video original series . In the Pokémon franchise, she provided the English voice of Haru in the stop-motion animated series Pokémon Concierge.
plainText:
Karen Fukuhara (born February 10, 1992) is an American actress. She is known for her roles as /Katana in the 2016 superhero film and as Kimiko Miyashiro in the Prime Video original series . In the Pokémon franchise, she provided the English voice of Haru in the stop-motion animated series Pokémon Concierge.

==Biography==
Karen Fukuhara was born to Japanese parents in , . Fukuhara's first language was Japanese, and she attended Japanese language school on Saturdays for 11 years. She has a younger brother. Fukuhara began practicing karate in middle school, and became a brown-striped belt before leaving for college.

Fukuhara attended , while working as a reporter for a sports show on in . Fukuhara graduated from UCLA in 2014 with a Bachelor of Arts in Sociology and a minor in Theater.

Fukuhara has also participated in an a cappella group.
